Independent blind solve and item-level English, Traditional Chinese, answer and each distractor verified after language corrections. Post-submission vocabulary and usage notes were independently checked against the unchanged item and canonical schema.

vocabulary.note: 只有判定無法修復的椅子才會貼紅標，供週五報廢收運；錯過本週維修收運不等於不能修。

activeQuestion.prompt: The repair truck collects broken chairs every Thursday, provided their green tags were attached by 5 p.m. the previous day. A contractor makes a separate Friday disposal trip that takes only red-tagged chairs, and red tags are issued only for chairs assessed as beyond repair. A chair can be fixed, but its green tag cannot be attached until Thursday morning. The chair must therefore ____.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 維修車每週四會來收走損壞的椅子，但椅子須在前一天下午 5 點前貼上綠標。承包商週五另有一趟報廢收運，只收貼有紅標的椅子；只有判定無法修理的椅子才會拿到紅標。有張椅子可以修，只是要到週四上午才能貼綠標。因此這張椅子必須____。

options.text: be held for the next repair collection
options.whyZh: 週四上午才貼綠標，已超過週四收運的貼標期限；椅子可修，不符合週五報廢的條件，因此須等下次維修收運。

options.text: be added to the Thursday repair load
options.zh: 列入週四的維修車收運清單
options.whyZh: 週四上午雖可貼標，但截至週三下午 5 點並未貼，因此來不及列入週四批次。

options.text: be transferred to the Friday disposal list
options.zh: 轉列入週五的報廢收運清單
options.whyZh: 週五收運只收無法修理的椅子；錯過維修收運不會使仍可修的椅子符合報廢條件。
椅子可以修，不代表已修好；它仍待維修，不能直接恢復正常使用。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 週四上午才貼綠標，已超過週四收運的貼標期限；椅子可修，不符合週五報廢的條件，因此須等下次維修收運。

originalQuestion.prompt: The city will ____ bids from qualified contractors until May 12.
originalQuestion.promptZh: 市政府將____合格承包商提交的投標文件，收件期限為五月十二日。

options.whyZh: except 不是此處收件所需的動詞。
access 指取得存取權或查看，不表示受理投標。
不能以 bids 作此語意的受詞。
accept bids 指受理投標文件，符合市政府公告收件期限的語境。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: accept bids 指受理投標文件，符合市政府公告收件期限的語境。
originalQuestion.evidence: The city will accept bids from qualified contractors until May 12.
